# Gelabber v0.5.2

Polish for the web client and a cleaner Linux desktop window, reviewed in
#178 and #179.

## Web client

- One 52 px header line across server rail, channel list, conversation and
  member list. Search sits in the channel header instead of its own bar; on
  phones the navigation button joins that header.
- Message actions (edit, delete, add reaction) appear in a small toolbar on
  hover or focus, a tap on touch, instead of under every message.
  Reactions are pills, attachments cards, editing stays inline.
- The composer is one field with attach and send; the Enter hint is gone and
  the character counter only shows near the limit. "Zu den neuesten
  Nachrichten" floats above it.
- The channel list starts with the server name and its invite, create and
  settings buttons; the brand row, banner, member count and the permanent
  create buttons are gone.
- Calls: on wider windows the controls are a card above your user panel
  instead of a bar across the whole width; on phones they stay a compact bar
  that wraps on narrow screens. Volume and "Ton teilen" are in the voice
  settings; voice and stream volume show while a stream plays.
- Everything uses the theme colours, so all built-in and custom themes, light
  and dark, pick up the new look.

## Desktop app

- No more menu bar above the app.
- If the stored server does not answer at start, the server screen opens with
  the reason and an "Erneut verbinden" button instead of an error page. This
  also works for IP addresses, including IPv6 such as `http://[::1]:8080`.
- **Strg+Umschalt+S** or **Server wechseln …** in the user menu opens the
  server screen from any page; **F5** / **Strg+R** reload.
- Arch: `yay -Syu` brings the update. Signing key fingerprint:
  `5992A8FD7578E86E36D45A4001C81EE2C2C0BBC5`.

## Upgrade and operation

- No migrations, no `.env` changes. The image set
  (`GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE`) moves to `v0.5.2` together; rolling back
  to v0.5.1 touches no data.

## Open

- If the server goes away during a session and the page is reloaded, the
  desktop app shows WebKit's error page, where the shortcut does not work;
  restarting the app leads to the server screen.
- Acceptance of the desktop app on real NVIDIA and Intel hardware and the
  H264 licensing question remain as listed in v0.5.0.
